# Style catalog fixtures — attribution

All images in this directory are in the public domain. Two sources:

* **Pre-1928 watercolor paintings** — the artists died over 70 years ago
  and the works are in the public domain worldwide. The photographic
  reproductions are also public domain per Wikimedia Commons policy and
  US copyright law (faithful reproductions of 2D PD works).
* **NASA works** — products of the US federal government are not subject
  to copyright in the United States (17 U.S.C. § 105).

Downloaded from Wikimedia Commons via `tools/fetch_spike_exemplars.sh`.
